sn22.9:1.4: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekho hoti,
sn22.9:1.6: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn22.9:1.16: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekho hoti,
sn22.9:1.18: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotīti.
